source_commit: de2b340 (DK0-M2 continuation base; M3 deltas uncommitted at generation time)

blocked_items.detail: CNG ECDSA P-256 sign/verify implemented and unit-tested (tamper detection, four trust states). No production signing key exists yet; the console library runs the documented --allow-unsigned development policy (ADR-0025 §trust). Production trust anchor is a future milestone.

verified_items.detail: Official NIST vectors pass; cross-checked against Windows BCrypt on real data. Rename-invariance and modification-sensitivity proven.
Identical inputs produce byte-identical package metadata and identity; one-byte source change produces a different identity. No timestamps/randomness/machine paths in canonical bytes.
Binary container: magic 'DC11G', u32 member count, per-member path+len+bytes. Truncation and corruption fail closed with reason codes.
Corrupted manifest, wrong hash, missing object, unsupported platform, bad semver, truncation, foreign schema — every case fails closed with a structured reason code.

Objects stored under store/objects/sha256/<h2>/<h62>; generation views fully materialized and byte-verified before the active.json pointer swap. Failed installs leave the previous generation active (tested).
ActivateGeneration points active.json at any fully validated prior generation; generation metadata records package_id/version provenance.

verified_items.item: Full acceptance chain with the PACKAGED artifact (§24)
verified_items.detail: pack -> verify -> install -> activate -> SHELL launches the installed generation's executable (not the source tree) through the supervisor with typed launch context -> QR1 suspend/resume (ok/ok) -> clean exit -> SHELL_ACTIVE. Proven by CTest fixture (package_library_install) + session_shell_selftest with DC_LIBRARY_DIR, and by test_package_e2e (pack/verify/install/activate/launch/update/corrupt-rollback in a temp root).
v0.1.0 installed and activated, v0.1.1 imports/activates/launches; a corrupted v0.1.2 fails closed and v0.1.1 remains active.
Re-installing the identical package (same content identity + version) no longer stacks generations; repeated CTest runs keep the same active generation. Corrupted variants still fail closed.
LaunchTitle resolves required_profiles from the installed package and evaluates them against measured DCP claims before TitleStarting; unsatisfied => toast + refusal, no degraded launch.
Saves owned by (user_id, game_id, save_schema); patch releases sharing save_schema remain recognized; incompatible schema requires explicit declared migration, never silent destruction.
dc.lifecycle/1 fields (suspend_ack_deadline_ms, quick_resume_tier, honors_exit_request, flushes_saves) flow through InstalledPackage into the supervisor's typed launch context.

Supervisor now re-enumerates title windows on a bounded grace loop so a Guide-suspend arriving before first window creation is delivered instead of silently lost; suspend/resume round-trip now ok/ok on the packaged title.

environment_limitations: No controller attached: package launch proven by automated selftest (input polling present, navigation clicks simulated by the framework), not by the §36 physical controller-only walk.
Signing trust anchor: unsigned development packages only; production signing policy deferred (documented, not hidden).
